    counts={v:sum(row.count(v) for row in grid) for v in set(sum(grid,[]))}

    edge=set(v for v in (grid[0]+grid[-1]+[row[0] for row in grid]+[row[-1] for row in grid]) if v!=bg)
    markers=[(r,c,grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c]!=bg and grid[r][c] not in edge]
    if not markers: return out
    color=markers[0][2]
    for r,c,v in markers: out[r][c]=4
    # Fill toward matching boundary along each marker's row/column.
    for r,c,v in markers:
        for dr,dc in ((0,1),(0,-1),(1,0),(-1,0)):
            rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
            while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==bg: rr+=dr; cc+=dc
            if 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc] in edge:
                rr,cc=r+dr,c+dc
                while 0<=rr<h and 0<=cc<w and grid[rr][cc]==bg:
                    out[rr][cc]=v; rr+=dr; cc+=dc
    # Boundary runs paint the whole inward row/column using marker color.
    for r in range(h):
        if grid[r][0] in edge and grid[r][0]!=bg:
            c=1
            while c<w and grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=color; c+=1
        if grid[r][-1] in edge and grid[r][-1]!=bg:
            c=w-2
            while c>=0 and grid[r][c]==bg: out[r][c]=color; c-=1
    return out
'''
